notes: Negative timing case. On seat 1's turn seat 0 uses Teferi, Master of Time's static (loyalty abilities on any player's turn) to phase out seat 1's Ogre. CR 502.1: only permanents that phased out under the ACTIVE player's control phase in, so seat 0's untap step on the next turn does not bring the Ogre back; it waits for seat 1's next untap step.
